<h2 class="iCIMS_InfoMsg iCIMS_InfoField_Job">



Overview


</h2>



<div class="iCIMS_InfoMsg iCIMS_InfoMsg_Job">
<div class="iCIMS_Expandable_Container">
<div class="iCIMS_Expandable_Text">
<p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Director, Manufacturing Project and Product Management</span></p><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt;">at Kyowa Kirin International plc</span></p><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt;">Marlow, UK</span></p><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt;"><strong> </strong></span></p><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt;"><strong>WE PUSH THE BOUNDARIES OF MEDICINE. </strong></span></p><p> </p><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt;"><strong>LEAPING FORWARD TO MAKE PEOPLE SMILE </strong></span></p><p> </p><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt;">At Kyowa Kirin International (KKI), our purpose is to make people smile. This means more than drug discovery and development; it is about embedding care into everything we do to make a difference every day for those that need it most. We’re an inclusive pharmaceutical company that takes time to understand what really matters to our patients, their families, and their healthcare professionals, helping our people to take bold actions that deliver life-changing solutions sooner. Our culture is rooted in our values: Teamwork, Commitment to Life, Innovation, and Integrity. They help us to push boundaries to deliver extraordinary impact and make KKI a brilliant place to work.</span></p><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt;"><strong> </strong></span></p><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt;"><strong>Job Purpose</strong></span></p><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt;">The Director of Project & Product Management (P&PM) provides senior leadership within CMC and associated organizations, responsible for driving the maximisation of the value of development candidates and commercial products through the development and execution of comprehensive CMC strategies across the product lifecycle</span></p>

</div>
</div>
</div>

Responsibilities

font-size: 10pt;">Establish, approve, and govern integrated CMC development strategies, action plans, and timelines for projects and products under the P&PM team’s responsibility</span></li><li><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt;">Oversee the timely execution and delivery of CMC and related functional milestones across multiple projects and products, ensuring consistency, quality, and prioritisation at the portfolio level</span></li><li><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt;">Provide strategic leadership and guidance on CMC development direction, enabling global teams to adapt plans proactively in response to scientific, technical, regulatory, or business changes</span></li><li><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt;">Monitor portfolio-level progress of CMC strategies and execution, ensuring optimal outcomes, value maximisation, and efficient resource utilisation across projects and products</span></li><li><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;
